releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.31 restores the proven local English spelling behavior from v0.11.29 after the v0.11.30 ranking regression. Misspelled English words should again receive reliable red wavy underlines and tap suggestions. The experimental heavy ranking layer is removed from the live editor. Grammar/context correction remains separate for a later step. Inbox improvements from v0.11.30 are preserved.
